name: first-in-class-oncology-digest
description: On-demand digest of novel first-in-class oncology targets and mechanisms disclosed across peer-reviewed literature, conference proceedings, company pipeline news, and SEC/regulatory filings. Now includes preclinical-stage novel target discoveries alongside clinical disclosures, and actively reviews cancer biology literature for new mechanistic insights that may reveal previously unrecognized therapeutic targets. Produces a structured Word report with summary table and full target briefs.
